spanda.title: EQ: four bands, analyzed
spanda.caption: The shelves and bells land where the knobs say.
spanda.settings: Low shelf 100 Hz, bells 500 Hz and 3 kHz, high shelf 8 kHz · each band alone at ±6 and ±12 dB · −18 dBFS sweep

spanda.title: EQ: bell width
spanda.caption: From a broad tilt to a narrow peak, all from one bell band.

spanda.title: Dynamics: static curve
spanda.caption: Analyzed input against output for four ratios.
spanda.settings: Threshold −24 dB, knee 6 dB, ratios 2, 4, 10 and 20 · stepped 1 kHz sine

spanda.title: Dynamics: attack and release
spanda.caption: Gain reduction over time for a level step.
spanda.settings: −40 → −6 → −40 dBFS step · threshold −24 dB, 4:1 · three attack/release pairs

spanda.title: Finisher: Logos harmonics
spanda.caption: A 1 kHz tone picks up harmonics as you push the drive.
spanda.settings: Logos, bias 6, drive 3 vs 12 · 1 kHz at −12 dBFS

spanda.title: Limiter: true-peak ceiling
spanda.caption: Push it 18 dB past full scale and the output still stops at −1 dBTP.
spanda.settings: Transparent mode, ceiling −1.0 dBTP · noise bursts and a 997 Hz sine, −12 to +18 dBFS · 4x-oversampled meter

galana.title: LP 24 across the range
galana.caption: A 24 dB/oct low-pass from 100 Hz to 10 kHz.
galana.settings: Drive type, resonance 0, Clean, drive 0 · −30 dBFS sweep

galana.title: Resonance
galana.caption: The peak rises past +15 dB and the bass thins as it does.

galana.title: HP 24 across the range
galana.caption: A 24 dB/oct high-pass at full level.

galana.title: Three of twelve filters
galana.caption: Same knob settings, three different shapes.
galana.settings: Drive, Ladder and Cascade · LP 24, 1 kHz, resonance 96

galana.title: Comb +
galana.caption: Tuned resonant teeth across the whole spectrum.

agni.title: Ten shapes, ten curves
agni.caption: Each shape bends the signal its own way. The loops come from the slot’s filters adding phase shift.
agni.settings: Slot A, drive +12 dB, bias 0 · one cycle of a 0 dBFS 100 Hz sine · quality 4x

agni.title: Harmonics
agni.caption: Four of the ten shapes. Soft and Hard add odd harmonics only; Tube and Germanium add even harmonics too.
agni.settings: Slot A, drive +12 dB, bias 0 · 1 kHz at −6 dBFS · quality 4x

agni.title: Oversampling
agni.caption: The worst alias falls from −24 dBFS at 1x to −82 dBFS at 8x.
agni.settings: Hard shape, drive +24 dB · 7 kHz tone at −6 dBFS

akasa.title: Six units, six decays
akasa.caption: Reverb time per octave band for the six units. Megha, Guha and Vayu get much shorter toward the highs; Valuka is nearly flat and Adi falls only slightly.

akasa.title: Each unit’s colour
akasa.caption: The wet spectrum of each unit, offset so the lines do not overlap. Each unit runs at its own internal sample rate, so most end between about 10 and 18 kHz.

akasa.title: Megha: decay per octave
akasa.caption: Reverb time falls from 2.9 s at 125 Hz to 1.4 s at 8 kHz, so the highs die away sooner than the lows. Below about −45 dB the bands bunch together and 8 kHz briefly outlasts the rest.
akasa.settings: Grand Hall, defaults (Vintage converters on) · −6 dBFS impulse

shunya.title: Reverb time per octave
shunya.caption: Reverb time per octave band for the six units. Most get shorter toward the highs, as in a real room; Chatur’s compact room is short and nearly flat.

shunya.title: Wet response per unit
shunya.caption: The wet spectrum of each unit, offset so the lines do not overlap. Kosha and Dhvani run at 32 kHz internally, so they end between about 14 and 17 kHz. The other units slope more gently toward the top.

shunya.title: Kosha: decay per octave
shunya.caption: Every band falls in a straight line, and the highs fall faster: 1.4 s at 8 kHz against 2.1 s at 125 Hz.

tula.title: Transparent on insert
tula.caption: Drop it on a track at default settings and nothing changes. The output nulls against the input to −158 dB, which is just float rounding.
tula.settings: Defaults: Trim 0, Out 0, Pan centre, Balance law, Width 100 % · log sweep 20 Hz–20 kHz at −12 dBFS

tula.title: Four pan laws
tula.caption: Each law lands exactly on its centre value: 0, −3.01, −4.52 and −6.02 dB.
tula.settings: Dual-mono 997 Hz at −12 dBFS · nine pan positions per law · level per side re input

tula.title: Width keeps the mono sum
tula.caption: Side follows the knob, −6 dB at 50 % and +6 dB at 200 %, while the mono sum doesn’t move at all.
tula.settings: Independent L/R pink noise at −18 dBFS RMS · mid (L+R) and side (L−R) re input
